description: This Java class defines an immutable data object named 'Metadata' which encapsulates information about a record of a 'thing' in a persistence layer, including identifiers, revision info, optional policy details, and timestamp metadata. It provides static factory methods for construction, including from responses, and accessor methods for its fields.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Immutable data class representing metadata for a 'thing' record, including its ID, revision, optional policy info, and last modified timestamp, with factory methods for creation and accessors for fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance with specified thing ID, revision, optional policy ID, and optional policy revision, without timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance with specified thing ID, revision, optional policy ID, optional policy revision, and modification timestamp.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Constructs a Metadata instance from an UpdateThingResponse object by extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this metadata.

methods.name: getThingRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the Thing according to the search index.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the PolicyId if present.

methods.name: getNamespaceInPersistence
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the ThingId for persistence purposes.

methods.name: getPolicyIdInPersistence
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the PolicyId for persistence, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getPolicyRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the revision of the policy, if any.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of last modification.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method for comparing Metadata instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode focusing on the fields used for equality.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Metadata object.
